summary: Iteration 35 — MO-009 QRU Visual Intelligence Studio™ + MO-010 Media Intelligence Division™ verified end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration35_visual_studio.py — (a) GET /api/visual-studio/config returns config (enabled, governing_standard='QRU Visual Intelligence Studio', 13 departments, 9 layout_rules, 11 quality_checks) + department_labels covering every department key, and requires auth (401/403 without token); (b) GET /api/visual-studio/media/config returns capabilities with integrations=9, total==9, live_count<=total, live_count=2 (openai + youtube), needs_key set (elevenlabs, heygen, google_flow, canva, runway, pika, vimeo) — honest MO-010 status; (c) GET /api/visual-studio/analyze/{product_id} returns product_id, layout_score in [0,100], violations list, passed bool, word_count; 404 on missing product; (d) GET /api/visual-studio/gold-review/{product_id} returns 11 checks including honest 'human_review' statuses on subjective checks (cover_invitation, first_spread, display, share, more), treasure_standard in {Met,Not Met}, gold_standard string, auto_score in [0,100], embedded layout; 404 on missing product; (e) GET /api/governance-binding/strip/design returns governed_by array (>=1 entry). Frontend Playwright end-to-end verified on preview URL: Founder login → sidebar nav-visual-studio visible and clickable → navigates to /visual-studio without error. Page renders PageHeader 'Visual & Media Studio™', vs-badge, vs-governed-by strip (STD-00021 · QRU Experience Design Architecture), vs-analyzer with vs-product select (125 real product options loaded from /api/founder-inbox) and vs-run button, vs-departments panel (13 department chips), vs-rules panel (9 layout rules + 11 quality checks), and vs-media panel showing '2/9 integrations live' with 9 media-{id} cards. Selecting PRD-00176 and clicking vs-run triggered both /api/visual-studio/analyze/{id} and /api/visual-studio/gold-review/{id}, rendered vs-results with layout_score=100/100, 401 words · 0 issue(s), Treasure Standard 'Met' Cleared, Gold Standard 'Pending Human Review', 6 auto-pass checks (reading density, understanding, memory, visual balance, eye flow, continuation) + 5 Human Review checks. Media panel chips correctly show 'Connected' for OpenAI/YouTube and 'Developer Setup Required' for ElevenLabs/HeyGen/Google Flow/Runway/Pika/Canva/Vimeo. No runtime errors on page.

issues: Pre-existing console warning 'In HTML, <span> cannot be a child of <option>' — emitted by the Emergent visual-editor tooling wrapping <option> text in a <span data-ve-dynamic='true'>, not by application code. Already documented in iteration 34. No functional impact on the Visual Studio page.

critical_code_review_comments: VisualStudio.js run(): the try/catch swallows all errors silently (`catch { /* noop */ }`). If /analyze or /gold-review returns 4xx/5xx the button just re-enables with no user feedback. Consider setting an error state and rendering a StatusChip 'Analysis failed' inside vs-results.

VisualStudio.js analysis-branch rendering: `gold.checks.map(...)` is dereferenced inside the `if (analysis)` block without also checking `gold` — if only /analyze resolves but /gold-review rejects, the `gold` state stays null and the second panel would throw a TypeError. Safer: `if (analysis && gold)` guard, or optional-chaining `gold?.checks?.map(...)`.

VisualStudio.js loads /api/founder-inbox and slices the first 200 products for the dropdown. Founder-inbox is an operational triage feed, not a product catalog — a dedicated /api/products endpoint (or the existing Product Library service) would be a more semantically correct source, and would avoid the current dependency on the Founder role/inbox visibility.

backend/visual_studio.py analyze_layout(): the `re` module is imported but only used inside gold_standard_review(). Move import to top of file is fine (currently already at top), but `analyze_layout` recomputes `nonempty` and `words` while `gold_standard_review` also invokes `analyze_layout` — a small redundancy that also causes the layout scan to run twice per Founder click (once via /analyze and once inside /gold-review). Consider memoizing per product_id per request or having gold_review accept a pre-computed layout.
backend/media_intelligence.py: `os` is imported but never used. Minor lint issue.

routers/visual_studio.py: analyze and gold_review both fetch the product with `db.products.find_one({'id': product_id})` and return the raw engine dict. If the MongoDB doc includes '_id' and any downstream field is added that carries ObjectId, it would fail JSON serialization. Currently safe because analyze/gold-review only return derived dicts, but keep the pattern (never spread the raw product) as the engine evolves.

VisualStudio.js: the header uses the trademark suffix in JSX text (‘Visual & Media Studio’) but the actual rendered header shows 'Visual & Media Studio™' — verify the PageHeader component isn't silently injecting a ™ that could break tests that assert exact text. Not blocking.

VisualStudio.js: no data-testid on the individual violation rows or check rows inside vs-results, only the parent grid has vs-results. For deeper e2e assertions (e.g., asserting a specific check status), recommend data-testid={`vs-check-${ck.check}`} and data-testid={`vs-violation-${i}`}.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (login → nav → page render → dropdown populated → Run Visual Review → results block populated → media integrations rendered with correct honest chips)

seed_data_creation: None. Reused existing seeded products (used PRD-00176 for the analyze+gold-review sample).
context_for_next_testing_agent: MO-009 (QRU Visual Intelligence Studio™) and MO-010 (Media Intelligence Division™) wired at backend prefix /api/visual-studio with endpoints /config, /media/config, /analyze/{product_id}, /gold-review/{product_id}. Frontend route /visual-studio with sidebar testid nav-visual-studio (under Manufacturing). Key data-testids on the page: vs-badge, vs-governed-by, vs-analyzer, vs-product, vs-run, vs-results, vs-departments, vs-rules, vs-media, media-{integration_id} (media-openai, media-youtube, media-elevenlabs, media-heygen, media-google_flow, media-runway, media-pika, media-canva, media-vimeo). Deterministic $0 engines (no LLM calls) — analyze produces layout_score 0-100 based on word count / heading / spacing heuristics; gold-review returns 11 checks with 5 honestly marked 'human_review' (Treasure Standard™: never fake visual judgment). Media capabilities.live_count=2 (openai+youtube), total=9. The dropdown is fed by /api/founder-inbox, so any product visible in Founder Review Inbox will appear here. All backend tests in /app/backend/tests/test_iteration35_visual_studio.py (8 cases) pass in ~2s.
rca of the issue: N/A — no defects. Two soft observations reported as critical_code_review_comments: (1) VisualStudio.js run() swallows errors with an empty catch, so a backend failure would silently leave the UI stuck without a message; (2) the second results panel dereferences `gold.checks` inside a guard that only checks `analysis`, so if /gold-review fails while /analyze succeeds a render-time TypeError would occur. Neither manifested during this test because the deterministic engines always succeed.
